Treatments

Three ways in. One plan for your skin.

Every treatment below starts with a consultation. What suits your skin, and how many sessions it takes, is decided there — not promised up front.

Laser

Medical-grade laser treatments

For tone, texture, and sun-related change, using a medical-grade laser menu that includes Halo, IPL/BBL, and Laser Genesis. Your provider matches the device and settings to your skin type and your goal.

  • Halo, IPL/BBL, and Laser Genesis
  • Full-face and targeted areas
  • Downtime and aftercare explained at consultation

Laser hair removal

Laser hair removal, planned in sessions

Smooth skin takes a course, not a single visit. Your plan sets the areas, the spacing between sessions, and what to expect between visits, so results build steadily.

  • Face and body areas
  • Session plans, not one-off promises
  • Aftercare guidance after every visit

Facials & skincare

Medical facials and skincare that continues at home

Treatments paired with medical-grade home care from brands the spa carries, including SkinCeuticals, Alastin, and SkinBetter. What you use between visits matters as much as the treatment itself.

  • Medical facials matched to your skin
  • SkinCeuticals, Alastin, and SkinBetter home care
  • A routine you can actually keep up

Questions, answered honestly

What visitors actually ask.

Why are there no prices on this page?

SpaDerma's own website does not publish treatment prices, so this concept page does not invent any. It proposes a full, transparent price menu on the spa's own site, and your exact price is confirmed at consultation before anything is booked.

Is this page for all SpaDerma locations?

No. This page is for the West Loop location only: 1048 W Madison St, Chicago, IL 60607. Its hours, phone number, and email below belong to that location.

What happens at a consultation?

You discuss your skin, your history, and your goal with a provider. Together you agree the treatment, the session plan, and the price — and nothing is booked until you are comfortable with all three.

Which treatments does the spa offer?

Medical-grade laser treatments including Halo, IPL/BBL, and Laser Genesis, laser hair removal, and medical facials with home care from SkinCeuticals, Alastin, and SkinBetter.

How do I book?

Use the form below, email info@spaderma.com, or call 773-529-5277. The form opens your own email app with a pre-filled message — nothing is stored on this page.
